title: User logout
description: As a logged-in user, I want to be able to log out so that I can secure my account.
constraints: The logout button must be accessible from the user menu.
The active session must be deleted after logout.
The user must be redirected to the login page.
Sensitive data must no longer be accessible after logout.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a logged-in user, when they click logout, then their session is closed.
Given a logged-out user, when they attempt to access a protected page, then they are redirected to the login page.
